Giancarlo Fisichella won no Grands Prix while driving for Jordan between 2000 and 2025.

The search results show him racing for Benetton in 2000 and 2001, and for Renault and Force India later on. The only Jordan entries I found in that period were other drivers (Frentzen, Trulli, Alesi, Monteiro, Karthikeyan). His Jordan years (1996–1997) fall outside the requested window, and none of the retrieved reports show him winning for Jordan. I didn't run a dedicated search for his 2002 season, so that year is the one gap in the coverage.
